products.name: Hemopurifier Immunotherapeutic Device

products.name: DT120 ODT (Lysergide D-tartrate Orally Disintegrating Tablet)

products.name: DT402 (R(-)-MDMA)
products.description: A proprietary form of the R-enantiomer of 3,4-methylenedioxymethamphetamine (MDMA), developed as a synthetic small molecule for the treatment of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and potentially other indications. products.name: Novel Psychoactive Compound Therapeutics (Pipeline/Research Programs)

products.name: Japanese Restaurant Dining Services
products.description: Operation of technology-enabled Japanese restaurants offering authentic Japanese cuisine, primarily sushi and a variety of side dishes, delivered through a revolving conveyor belt and express belt service model. Food is freshly prepared in-house using high-quality, non-artificial ingredients, and served in a multi-sensory, engaging dining environment.

products.name: Off-Premises Food Sales
products.description: Provision of Japanese cuisine for takeout and delivery, leveraging the restaurant menu and kitchen operations to serve customers outside the physical restaurant premises. This includes initiatives to increase off-premises sales and enhance digital ordering capabilities.

products.name: Alcoholic Beverage Sales
products.description: Sale of alcoholic beverages as a complement to the restaurant dining experience, subject to local and state licensing and regulations. Alcoholic beverages are a small but regulated part of the overall restaurant offering.

products.name: Mortgage-Backed Securities (MBS) Investments
products.description: Investment in a diversified portfolio of mortgage-backed securities, including agency and non-agency RMBS, CMBS, CLOs, and related structured products. These are acquired and managed through financial capital and require expertise in fixed income trading and risk management.

products.name: Residential and Commercial Mortgage Loan Investments
products.description: Acquisition, origination, and management of residential and commercial mortgage loans, including non-QM, bridge, fix-and-flip, non-performing, re-performing, and agency-eligible loans. These are sourced through various origination channels and may be held or securitized.

products.name: Reverse Mortgage Loan Origination and Servicing
products.description: Origination, servicing, and investment in reverse mortgage loans, including FHA-insured HECM loans and proprietary jumbo reverse mortgages, primarily through the Longbridge subsidiary. This business requires regulatory approvals and in-person and digital loan processing infrastructure.

products.name: Consumer Loan and Asset-Backed Securities (ABS) Investments
products.description: Investment in consumer loans and asset-backed securities backed by consumer loans, SBA loans, and retained tranches from securitizations. These are acquired through financial capital and require expertise in structured finance.

products.name: Corporate CLO and Debt Investments
products.description: Investment in corporate collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), including debt and equity tranches, and corporate loans and securities. These are managed as part of a diversified credit portfolio.

products.name: Mortgage-Related Derivatives and Hedging Instruments
products.description: Use of mortgage-related derivatives, such as TBAs, credit default swaps, and other instruments, to hedge interest rate, credit, and currency risks associated with the investment portfolio. These are traded digitally and require advanced financial modeling.

products.name: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs) and Related Investments
products.description: Acquisition and management of mortgage servicing rights and related investments, which generate fee income from servicing mortgage loans. This business requires regulated infrastructure and operational capabilities.

products.name: Strategic Equity and Debt Investments in Loan Originators and Servicers
products.description: Equity and/or debt investments in companies that originate or service loans, providing capital and sometimes entering into flow agreements to purchase loans. These investments support the company's sourcing and diversification strategy.

products.name: Real Estate Investments
products.description: Direct acquisition of commercial and residential real property, held as part of the investment portfolio. This requires physical asset management and real estate expertise.

products.name: Self Care Products
products.description: Over-the-counter (OTC) medicines and naturally inspired products for cough, cold, allergy, pain care, digestive health, smoking cessation, and eye care, delivered through physical manufacturing and regulated distribution channels, including digital diagnostics and telemedicine offerings.

products.name: Skin Health and Beauty Products
products.description: Dermatological and beauty products for face, body, hair, and sun care, manufactured using scientific expertise and partnerships with skin experts, distributed globally as physical goods and regulated as cosmetics or OTC drugs.

products.name: Essential Health Products
products.description: Personal care products including oral care, baby care, wound care, and menstrual health, produced through large-scale manufacturing and distributed globally, often regulated as medical devices, cosmetics, or OTC drugs.

products.name: Dietary Supplements
products.description: Dietary supplement products, including vitamins and wellness supplements, manufactured and distributed as ingestible goods, regulated as dietary supplements or food products in various jurisdictions.

products.name: Connected Health Offerings
products.description: Digital health solutions such as digital diagnostics and telemedicine, delivered via digital platforms and apps, sometimes regulated as medical devices or non-medical device apps depending on jurisdiction.

products.name: Public Transportation Software Platform
products.description: A unified, cloud-based, modular software platform for planning, operating, and optimizing public transit networks, including planning and scheduling, real-time operations management, fleet and driver management, rider management, and data analytics. Delivered as configurable SaaS to government and transit agencies.

products.name: Technology-Enabled Transit Services
products.description: A suite of operational services provided alongside the software platform, including driver management, fleet management, customer support, and marketing services, delivered either directly or through third-party partners to help customers operate and adopt modern transit solutions.

products.name: Passenger-Facing Mobility Applications
products.description: Consumer-grade mobile applications, including white-labeled rider apps and the Citymapper app, enabling passengers to plan, book, and pay for multimodal transit journeys, with options for city branding and in-app advertising.

products.name: Transit Planning and Consulting Services
products.description: Consultative services leveraging proprietary simulation technology and data analytics to guide transit agencies through service planning, feasibility studies, and financial modeling, supporting the adoption and optimization of transit solutions.

products.name: Autonomous Vehicle Integration and Operations
products.description: Software and services for integrating and managing autonomous vehicles within public transit networks, including deployment, routing, and real-time monitoring of autonomous shuttles across various geographies and use cases.

products.name: Mobility Data and Insights Solutions
products.description: Data analytics and benchmarking tools providing real-time and historical insights into transit network performance, passenger behavior, and operational optimization, delivered through dashboards and reporting packages to transit agencies.

products.name: Packaging and Specialty Plastics
products.description: Manufactured polyethylene, polyolefin elastomers, ethylene copolymers, and related specialty plastics for use in packaging, health and hygiene, mobility, infrastructure, and consumer applications. Production is based on large-scale, integrated chemical manufacturing using proprietary catalyst and process technologies.

products.name: Industrial Intermediates and Infrastructure Chemicals
products.description: Produced and marketed ethylene oxide and propylene oxide derivatives, including purified ethylene oxide, amines, solvents, glycol ethers, alkoxylates, and surfactants, as well as polyurethane systems, propylene glycol, polyether polyols, isocyanates, and construction chemicals. Products are manufactured at global chemical plants and serve diverse industrial, construction, and consumer markets.

products.name: Coatings and Performance Monomers
products.description: Manufactured acrylics-based building blocks, binders, additives, and monomers for use in architectural and industrial paints, coatings, adhesives, inks, plastics, and paper. Production involves large-scale chemical synthesis and formulation, serving both consumer and industrial end-markets.

products.name: Performance Silicones and Specialty Materials
products.description: Produced silicone-based materials, including adhesives, sealants, antifoams, surfactants, fluids, emulsions, and elastomers, for use in electronics, personal care, industrial processing, infrastructure, and mobility. Products are manufactured using silicon metal and siloxane chemistry at world-scale facilities.

products.name: Hydrocarbon Monomers and Aromatics
products.description: Produced ethylene, propylene, benzene, butadiene, aromatics, and related hydrocarbon monomers, primarily for internal use but also sold externally. Production is based on large-scale petrochemical processing and cracking operations.

products.name: Chlor-Alkali and Vinyls
products.description: Produced chlorine, caustic soda, ethylene dichloride, and vinyl chloride monomer, primarily for internal consumption but with some external sales. Manufacturing involves electrochemical and chemical processing at dedicated facilities.

products.name: Intelligent Diagnostics (Oncology and Hereditary Testing)
products.description: Comprehensive suite of laboratory diagnostic tests, including next-generation sequencing (NGS), PCR profiling, and anatomic/molecular pathology, primarily for oncology (solid tumors, hematologic malignancies, liquid biopsy, minimal residual disease, hereditary cancer risk) and hereditary conditions. Tests are performed in high-throughput labs and results are personalized using AI and multimodal patient data.

products.name: Neuropsychiatry Pharmacogenomic Testing
products.description: Pharmacogenomic profiling for patients with psychiatric conditions (e.g., depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder), using proprietary assays to analyze genetic variants affecting drug response. Delivered via laboratory testing and results are used to guide medication selection.

products.name: Data Licensing and Analytics (Insights)
products.description: Licensing of large, de-identified, multimodal clinical, molecular, and imaging datasets to pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, along with analytic and cloud-compute tools for drug discovery, development, and research. Data is structured, harmonized, and updated over time, and accessed via proprietary software applications.

products.name: Clinical Trial Matching and Support Services (Trials)
products.description: AI-powered clinical trial matching services for pharmaceutical companies and healthcare providers, identifying and enrolling patients into clinical trials using real-time clinical and molecular data. Includes management and execution of clinical trials through a contract research organization (Tempus Compass).

products.name: AI-Driven Care Gap Identification and Decision Support (Next)
products.description: AI platform that applies machine learning to clinical data to proactively identify and minimize care gaps for oncology and cardiology patients, including monitoring for missed testing or high-risk conditions. Delivered as a digital application integrated with provider workflows.

products.name: Algorithmic Diagnostics (Algos)
products.description: Suite of algorithm-based diagnostic tests (e.g., Tumor Origin, HRD, DPYD, Purist, Atrial Fibrillation) developed using multimodal data and AI, deployed clinically to predict disease characteristics, risk, or therapy response in oncology and cardiology. Delivered as software or integrated with lab tests.

products.name: Organoid Modeling and Drug Screening Services
products.description: Laboratory-based creation and use of tumor-derived organoids for in vitro drug screening and biological modeling, offered to pharmaceutical and biotech clients to test therapeutic hypotheses and support drug development.

products.name: Subscriber Connectivity Solutions
products.description: Hardware and software products enabling wired and wireless connectivity at customer premises, including residential gateways, Wi-Fi access points, routers, switches, and edge compute devices. These are physically manufactured devices and digital software, delivered to service providers and enterprises for residential and business subscriber access.

products.name: Access & Aggregation Solutions
products.description: Hardware and software platforms for connecting residential, business, and mobile networks to metro networks, primarily via fiber. Includes optical line terminals, copper access devices, packet aggregation platforms, network synchronization/timing solutions, and orchestration software. Delivered as physical network equipment and digital management tools to service providers.

products.name: Optical Networking Solutions
products.description: Hardware and software for secure, high-capacity interconnection of metro and regional networks over fiber, including open optical terminals, line systems, optical subsystems/modules, and automation platforms. Delivered as manufactured equipment and digital platforms to service providers, content providers, and large enterprises.

products.name: Network Design, Implementation, and Support Services
products.description: Comprehensive services including network design, deployment, maintenance, professional services, and managed services for multi-vendor networks. Delivered through in-person human labor and remote support, backed by global support teams with varying service level agreements.

products.name: Cloud-Hosted SaaS and Network Management Software
products.description: Cloud-based software applications for network and service optimization, including AI-driven operations, network orchestration, and management platforms (e.g., Mosaic One, Mosaic Network Controller, n-Command, Procloud). Delivered digitally as SaaS to service providers and enterprises for managing fiber access, Wi-Fi, and optical networks.

products.name: SmartVest Airway Clearance System (including SmartVest SQL and SmartVest Clearway)
products.description: A medical device system that delivers High Frequency Chest Wall Oscillation (HFCWO) therapy for airway clearance, consisting of a programmable air pulse generator, inflatable therapy garment (vest or wrap), and connecting hose. The system is manufactured at the company's facility, requires FDA clearance, and is delivered directly to patients or sold to hospitals for use in homecare and acute care settings.

products.name: Single Patient Use (SPU) SmartVest and SmartVest Wrap
products.description: Disposable, single-patient-use versions of the SmartVest garment designed for use in acute care settings such as hospitals. These products provide full coverage oscillation for airway clearance therapy during inpatient care and facilitate continuity of care when transitioning to home use.

products.name: Patient and Clinician Education, Training, and Support Services
products.description: Comprehensive support services provided alongside device sales, including patient and clinician education, in-home training on device use, and ongoing follow-up to ensure proper integration of therapy into daily routines. Delivered by a network of respiratory therapists and support staff.

products.name: Major Home Appliances
products.description: Manufactured and marketed full line of large household appliances including laundry appliances, refrigerators and freezers, cooking appliances, and dishwashers. These are physically produced in factories and distributed globally through retailers, distributors, builders, and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Small Domestic Appliances
products.description: Manufactures and markets small kitchen and household appliances, such as stand mixers and countertop appliances, primarily under the KitchenAid brand. These are physically produced and sold globally through retailers, distributors, and direct-to-consumer channels.

products.name: Commercial Laundry Appliances
products.description: Produces and sells commercial-grade laundry equipment for use in laundromats, multi-housing, and other commercial settings. These are physically manufactured and distributed to commercial customers.

products.name: Food Waste Disposers and Instant Hot Water Dispensers
products.description: Manufactures and sells food waste disposers and instant hot water dispensers for both home and commercial use, primarily under the InSinkErator brand. These are physically produced and distributed through retail and commercial channels.

products.name: Connected Appliances and Digital Services
products.description: Offers connected home appliances with features such as WiFi connectivity, voice control compatibility, and over-the-air software updates, supported by a mobile app platform. These are delivered as part of physical appliances with ongoing digital enhancements.

products.name: Brand Licensing
products.description: Licenses its trademarks and intellectual property to third parties who manufacture, sell, and service products under Whirlpool-owned brands. This is a contractual service generating royalty revenue.
